sources.title: Beyond the HUD: User Interfaces for Increased Player Immersion in FPS Games
sources.publisher: Erik Fagerholt and Magnus Lorentzon / Chalmers University of Technology
sources.verification: Opened and read relevant primary-source sections

sources.title: 10 Usability Heuristics for User Interface Design

sources.title: Flat UI Elements Attract Less Attention and Cause Uncertainty
sources.verification: Opened and read relevant primary-source sections
supports: 在特定网页目标定位实验中，弱可点击线索增加搜索代价
caveats: 71名网页用户、9对页面、寻找点击位置的任务
不等于完整游戏任务实验；不将22%结果外推为所有平面UI更慢

sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 101: Text display
